hints.title: Running Maximum Prefix Element
hints.text: Maintain a running variable representing max(nums[0..i]) as you iterate from left to right.

hints.title: Conversion Value Computation
hints.text: At each index i, the converted element is conver[i] = nums[i] + max_prefix.

hints.title: Cumulative Score Sum
hints.text: Maintain a running sum of conver[i] values to produce the score array.

hints.title: Running Prefix Score Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def findPrefixScore(self, nums: list[int]) -> list[int]:
        max_val = 0
        total_score = 0
        ans = []
        for x in nums:
            max_val = max(max_val, x)
            total_score += x + max_val
            ans.append(total_score)
        return ans
```

complexity.notes: Single pass maintaining running maximum and running prefix score.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recomputing the prefix maximum and prefix sums at each step takes O(n^2).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) auxiliary space beyond the output list.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Maintains running maximum and running sum in a single pass.
